exposure.needed: whether any tooling or alerting reads Strimzi Pod-restart Kubernetes events and selects or filters them by regardingObject or related

original.statement: Kubernetes events that Strimzi emits during a Pod restart now have the Kafka resource as the `regardingObject` and the Pod in the `related` field.

decision.reason: [ev-4308bfa38162] only says that Pod-restart events now use the Kafka resource as `regardingObject` and the Pod as `related`. It does not say that anything fails. The environments affected are those whose event consumers (watchers, alerts, dashboards) select or filter these events by `regardingObject` or `related`. No Helm value, CRD field or manifest shows that, so an undecidable runtime-behavior-gap condition fits. A gvk-in-use Kafka condition (P3) would flag every Strimzi user whether or not they read these events, so it would be too broad.
